determinismContract.evidenceClass: DESIGN PROPOSAL (mirrors VERIFIED FROM CURRENT SNAPSHOT diplomacy style)
rules: NO RNG and NO seeds, matching FSoulDiplomacyRules::Evaluate (Source/SoulCore/Private/SoulDiplomacy.cpp:10-37, comment line 23: no hidden information or random roll).
Fixed-scale integer arithmetic only. All values are gold (int32) or permille scores (0..1000).
Pure function of: captured hero's Level/Kind, days held (day - CaptureDay), current diplomatic RelationPermille, stance, and treasuries. No hidden state.

Same inputs => same output on every machine and every reload. Placement: new SOULCORE_API FSoulRansomRules in SoulCore (sibling of FSoulDiplomacyRules), so it has zero engine/UObject dependency and is unit-testable headless like FSoulDiplomacyRules.

economicAnchors.interpretation: A hero is worth far more than a single unit (140-220g) and comparable in magnitude to a full re-hire (1200g). Ransom values below are calibrated so paying ransom is usually cheaper than re-growing/re-leveling a lost commander, but still a meaningful 2-6 day income hit (income is 450g/day).

formula.comment_decay: Longer captivity reduces the realistic ransom (captor's leverage erodes; owner may write the hero off). Floors at 600 permille (=60%) after 10 days held. Deterministic, bounded.
formula.comment_relation: Warmer relations slightly lower the ask (goodwill); bitter enemies demand more. Bounded +/-25%.

ransomValuation.integerOrderOfOperations: Multiply before dividing by 1000 at each stage to keep deterministic integer rounding; document exact op order in code comment so Codex reproduces the worked examples byte-for-byte.

captorOfferScoring.description: When the OWNER proposes to pay ransom to free their captured hero, the captor AI decides accept/reject deterministically. Mirrors FSoulDiplomacyRules::Evaluate 0..1000 fixed-scale with 500 threshold.
captorOfferScoring.function: FSoulRansomRules::EvaluateRansomOffer(relation, offeredGold, valueGold, stance, day) -> FSoulDiplomaticDecision-shaped payload

components.payment_ratio: clamp((offeredGold * 500) / max(1, valueGold) - 200, -400, 400)  // full-value offer ~ +300; low-ball offer negative
components.war_premium: stance==War ? -150 : 0  // at war, captor is more reluctant to free an enemy asset cheaply
components.staleness: +min(daysHeld,10)*10  // captor more willing to offload over time

captorOfferScoring.reasonsStyle: Human-readable explainable strings exactly like SoulDiplomacy.cpp Evaluate (e.g. 'Base 350; payment +300; relation +50; war -150; staleness +40. Score 590/1000; needs 500.').
captorOfferScoring.note: Player-vs-AI only in V1 (the player initiates). AI-captor acceptance is deterministic and fully previewable before the player commits, like PreviewDiplomacy.

aiInitiatedRansomDemand.description: When the AI holds the PLAYER's hero (Hero.Condition==Captured, CaptorFaction is an AI faction), the AI posts a standing ransom DEMAND the player may accept.
aiInitiatedRansomDemand.demandGold: FSoulRansomRules::ValueGold(playerHeroLevel, kind, daysHeld, relation)  // identical valuation, symmetric
aiInitiatedRansomDemand.playerAcceptanceIsAlwaysLegalIfAffordabl: The player accepting a demand is a direct transaction (like Gift): costs demandGold + 1 movement; always 'accepted' by the captor by construction. Preview shows the exact gold and the resulting release location (see exchange_rules.md).
aiInitiatedRansomDemand.noCoercion: No torture/execution/escalating-demand systems (explicitly out of scope per lane prompt). The demand is a flat, decaying number; refusing simply leaves the hero captured.

rules: All gold figures clamped to [300, 100000] to stay inside save int validation envelope.
offeredGold must be <= owner treasury (checked at subsystem layer before Apply, mirroring Gift's 250-gold affordability gate in PreviewDiplomacy, SoulHeartlandDiplomacy.cpp:23).
Recipient-treasury overflow guard (MAX_int32-ransom) exactly like the Gift overflow guard (SoulHeartlandDiplomacy.cpp:23).
Scoring never reads hidden information: only persisted relation + public hero level/kind + day.
